BrandDiscovery.title: Brand search
BrandDiscovery.description: Select influencers with an active ideal profile and discover candidate brands. On approved brands you can search multiple contacts/emails.

BrandDiscovery.emptyFilteredResults: No brands with this status for this influencer.

BrandDiscovery.influencerSectionDescription: Brands discovered for this influencer. Filter by review status.

businessContacts.title: Brand business contacts
businessContacts.description: Commercial emails found on the brand website or search snippets with literal evidence. Separate from person leads.
businessContacts.emptyAfterProviderFailure: No brand business contacts were saved because Bright Data did not return usable content. Check the provider-failure notice above, or retry when the integration is healthy.
businessContacts.emptyAfterNoMatches: Search finished successfully: brand pages were opened, but no literal emails (like hello@brand.com) were in the HTML. This is not a system failure.
businessContacts.emptyAfterFailed: The run failed. Contacts below may be from a partial attempt (no run link).

sections.genericDescription: Department or role inboxes (partnerships@, info@, press@, …) kept when found with literal evidence.
sections.genericEmpty: No generic brand inboxes persisted yet.
sections.otherDescription: Emails that look personal or are free-mail, still tied to this brand with evidence.
sections.otherEmpty: No other commercial emails persisted yet.
sections.agenciesPending: Agency discovery (track 2C) is not implemented yet. Agencies are not invented or attributed as brand inboxes.

LeadDiscovery.panelDescription: Discover relevant people and their contact channels. Review, approve, and optionally select one for future outreach (no email is sent).
LeadDiscovery.rebuildModeBanner: Contact discovery search is temporarily disabled while the system is rebuilt. Historical leads and business contacts remain available to review and edit.
LeadDiscovery.bbcV1PersonLeadsBanner: Contact Discovery BBC v1 is active: search creates brand business contacts (panel above), not person leads. You can still review and curate historical leads here.

bbc.activeBanner: Brand business contacts (2A): AI + Bright Data (SERP/Unlocker). Literal website emails only — never invented. The LinkedIn people panel is hidden in this mode.
bbc.processingBody: The AI research job is running (brand pages ± SERP). This is not an error.
bbc.partialProcessingTitle: Search in progress — contacts already visible
bbc.partialProcessingBody: {count} business contact(s) exist for this brand while the run is still PROCESSING. They may be partial or orphaned (no runId link).
bbc.resultsFoundPartial: Some pages failed; results may be partial.
bbc.noMatchesTitle: No literal emails on the website
bbc.noMatchesBody: The system responded successfully. It opened brand pages and found no emails written in the HTML (many brands only offer a form).
bbc.providerFailureBody: Bright Data did not return reliable content ({kind}). This is not the same as “no matches”.
bbc.failedBody: The run failed in the application or while persisting status.
bbc.failedOrphansNote: Business contacts exist for this brand; the model does not link them to this run (no runId).

LeadDiscovery.emptyLeadsLegitimate: Search finished with no matching people. This is a valid empty result, not a technical failure.
LeadDiscovery.emptyLeadsAfterProviderFailure: No leads were saved because a discovery provider failed. See the warning above.

runOutcome.emptyLegitimateBody: The search completed without critical provider errors, but no valid contacts were found.
runOutcome.bbcOnlyTitle: Business contacts found, no person leads
runOutcome.bbcOnlyBody: Brand business contacts were saved. Person lead discovery did not produce qualified LinkedIn profiles above the ranking threshold.
runOutcome.resultCounts: Business contacts created: {businessContacts}; person leads created: {personLeads}
runOutcome.peopleTraceSummary: Search hits: {hits}; LinkedIn profiles validated: {linkedin}; above threshold: {qualified}
